content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university with campuses including Amritapuri, where this post is based. The vacancy sits in the Green Hydrogen Lab, which carries out experimental research on hydrogen generation and related materials.

content_sections.heading: Research Assistant Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant will contribute to research publications, patents and project milestones. The key responsibilities are: Carrying out experimental research in the lab's focus areas Preparing and characterising materials Designing and running hydrogen generation experiments Analysing experimental data and interpreting results Maintaining clear documentation of experiments and findings Taking part in other research-related activities of the lab

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Research Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Research Assistant job page on the Amrita website. Use the Apply Now or Apply Online option on that page to submit your application. For details about the post, write to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Amrita Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applicants need an MSc in Chemistry or Physics, or an MTech in Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. Is hydrogen energy experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. The notice lists experience in the hydrogen energy field as desirable, not as a requirement.

faq.question: Q3. Can this post lead to a PhD?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates in this post will have a pathway to register for a PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What work will the Research Assistant do?
faq.answer: The main tasks include preparing and characterising materials, running hydrogen generation experiments and analysing the resulting data.

faq.question: Q5. Which lab is this vacancy in?
faq.answer: The vacancy is in the Green Hydrogen Lab at the Amritapuri Campus.

faq.question: Q6. Whom can I contact about this vacancy?
faq.answer: The notice gives [email protected] as the contact for details.
